name: AiChat
title: Blocks/Ai/AiChat
summary: The full-page generative AI assistant in the chat-app look: a thread history grouped by date (search, a project filter, New thread; each row shows its project, the Azion product it started on with how many it touches or the version it edits, a `HoverCard` of details, and Snooze and Settle) in a side panel on desktop and a start `Drawer` behind a floating menu button on a phone; no header bar, only floating controls over the thread: on a phone the menu button and one grouped New chat and More control, on desktop the title of the open conversation with Share and More (Rename, Archive, Delete) at the end; before the first message a welcome page with "What can I help with?", the composer in the middle on desktop and at the foot on a phone, and the support prompts as `SuggestionGroup` chips; then a `Conversation` in a centered reading column where the reader's prompts sit in bubbles at the inline end and each response is plain text in a `ChatMessage` that goes pending (loading text), thinking (`Reasoning`), streaming (`StreamingResponse` with site-name citation chips) and complete (Copy, Feedback with Good and Bad response, Read aloud, Share, Try again and More, with the `Sources` pill on the same line; a `FeedbackReasonDialog` after Bad response and a `ResponseBranches` pager over regenerated answers and edited prompts, which carry Copy and Edit), followed by follow-up questions; a `PromptInput` pinned at the foot of the column while the thread scrolls behind it, with the "+" menu at the start (Camera, Photos, Files, then tools such as Web search that ride in the composer as chips, `v-model:toolKeys`), the model picker (`v-model:modelKey`, the only one on the page) and Dictate before the button at the end (Start voice conversation while empty, Send once there is text, Stop while a response is generated), a 4,000-character limit whose counter appears near it, and the disclaimer under it on desktop. The primary state is the empty assistant; sending a support prompt runs the whole response cycle. Built from `ChatMessage`, `Conversation`, `HoverCard`, `Drawer`, `DropdownMenu`, `PromptInput`, `StreamingResponse`, `Reasoning`, `Sources`, `SuggestionGroup`, `Button`, `IconButton`, `ResponseBranches` and `FeedbackReasonDialog`. Takes the messages of TanStack AI's `useChat` as they are and reports share, edit, branch, version changes and feedback for the app to run with `setMessages`, `sendMessage` and `reload`. A page body for ConsoleLayout that fills its content region (`data-layout-fill`).

variants.name: Streaming
variants.summary: A response arriving: the reader asked why storefront returns 502 errors and the answer streams in with its caret, a table on the way, the region busy and Stop in the composer; when it ends the sources, actions and follow-up questions appear.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: A response that failed mid-stream: the partial text stays, the error line says the connection was interrupted and Try again regenerates the response in place.

variants.name: LongThread
variants.summary: Six earlier turns about one workload that overflow the log: it opens on the newest response and its Sources pill, stops following when the reader scrolls up, and the round Scroll to the latest message button above the composer brings them back; follow-up questions close the thread.

variants.name: Artifact
variants.summary: An answer that produced a file: the message carries an `ArtifactPreview` of top-orders.sql and the `ArtifactCanvas` sits beside the conversation in a `Resizable` pane of the same chat shell (the `turn-end` and `canvas` slots of the chat) (a `Drawer` under the md breakpoint) with its versions, Copy, Download and Close; a follow-up question is sent like in every other state. While a new version is written the canvas takes `streaming`, which locks its pager.

variants.name: Media
variants.summary: A prompt with an attached image, then an answer with a chart tool result, two charts in an `ImageGallery`, a structured answer, a CSV in a `FilePreview` and an audio summary; the composer attaches files.

variants.name: Agent
variants.summary: `AgentActivity` steps, a finished `SubagentCard` and a pending `AgentQuestion` that keeps its answer.
